# Architecture responsibility
Use the existing application architecture and captured stack profile. Describe boundaries and failure behavior, and preserve repository conventions for authentication, persistence and deployment. The backend OpenAPI contract defines the frontend interface. Apply Python/FastAPI and React/TypeScript/Vite guidance; avoid adding infrastructure without story scope. Architecture does not grant write or execution authority to read-only roles.
